inputs: Only 56 dated daily sales before origin and frozen point forecast for the selected model. No actual, actual_days, future residual or current interval miss used in signals.

signals.trend: Last 14-day weekly mean / previous 42-day weekly mean; at least 2 or at most 0.5 AND absolute weekly mean change at least 10 units. If previous mean is zero, recent mean at least 10 is a rise; both zero is not a change.
signals.sparse: At least half of the 56 recorded daily sales equal zero; zero does not establish stock availability or store closure.
signals.volatile: Population standard deviation of eight consecutive past seven-day totals / their mean at least 1; undefined if mean is zero.
signals.extrapolation: Selected frozen point prediction strictly outside min/max of the same eight past weekly totals. This is an output-vs-history check, not a cause or proof of error.
signals.combined: Any of the four checks; unweighted OR for manual review only, not a calibrated risk score. All individual checks also retained.

outcomes.large_error: abs(actual - prediction) > max(1, historical 56-day total / 8); diagnostic unit is one historical average week, not a business acceptance threshold.
outcomes.spike: Actual seven-day total strictly exceeds maximum of eight historical seven-day totals; determined only after target completes.
outcomes.interval: Reuse E3 unchanged. Miss outside inclusive bounds; width / max(1, historical weekly mean) at least 2 marked broad for comparison, not unusable by universal rule. First four origins have no interval.

scope: All 144 product-weeks for point diagnostics, same 96 E3 eligible product-weeks for intervals. Every model and all 12 windows and 12 items retained. No significance or independent repeated-trial claim.
report: Each signal and combined flag: flagged/unflagged counts, large errors, spikes, interval eligible/misses, false alarms relative to large-error definition, missed large errors, WAPE, bias and mean width. Show complete window and sample replay.
restrictions: Thresholds are transparent diagnostic conventions fixed before this new cross-tab calculation, not selected for best outcome. Existing labels and E3 findings were already known; this is not a new preregistered independent evaluation.
No retraining, threshold search, forecast or interval change, automatic routing or stock order recommendation.
Absence of flags is not proof of reliability. Current target outcomes may explain a failure after the event, never change pre-origin advice.

No verified promotion, stock, availability, lead-time, price schedule, customer-order mix or cause information in the weekly replay. Additional business inputs are hypotheses to audit, not established causes.
Daily 28-day forecast excluded; do not apply weekly thresholds or pool its horizons as independent windows.
